svg.text: Long-route cost is a separate budget
Derived link traversals, not measured execution time. Both chart axes are logarithmic.
Each indexed lookup starts at the list head
Scan every pair: pt(i), pt(i + 1) → total link traversals = (n − 1)²
More sections spend CPU even when every map block stays below 1200 entries.
